pitch:
# A booking page for a hair salon

## 1. People and their journey
**Client** (the only role). Wants to see which times are free for a service and book one without phoning.
Path: arrives, picks a service, picks a day, picks a free time, enters name, phone and email, submits, sees a confirmation showing the request as "Requested".
Salon staff confirm requests outside the interface; they get no screens or controls.

## 2. How it looks
A single calm, light, centred booking page in a salon's style: warm off-white background, deep plum text and accents, rounded cards, generous spacing.

- Page background: flat warm off-white (#FAF6F2), full width, behind everything.
- Header: top of the page, flat plum (#4A2B3F) band with the white title "Book an appointment".
- Progress cards: three stacked white raised cards (Service, Time, Your details) in a centred column 640px wide, each with a plum heading.
- Service option: a white outlined card with service name and duration in minutes, e.g. "Cut, 45 min". Hover: the border turns rose (#C0728A). Selected: plum border with a pale rose (#F6E3E8) fill and a check mark.
- Day strip: a row of the next 14 days, each a small outlined tile with weekday and date. Selected: solid plum with white text. Today: a small rose dot. Days with no free times: greyed text, not clickable. Before a service is chosen the strip is faded and disabled.
- Time slot: a pill button listing a start time, in a grid under the day strip. Free: white with plum outline. Hover: rose outline. Selected: solid plum, white text. Taken: grey (#E4E0DC) fill, struck-through text, not clickable.
- Empty-times note: grey text under the strip, shown when the chosen day has no free times.
- Details fields: Name, Phone, Email, each a text box with a label above and a grey outline. Focus: plum outline. Error: red (#B3261E) outline with a red message beneath.
- Summary line: sits above the submit button and shows the service, day, time and end time in plum text.
- Submit button "Request booking": full width, solid plum, white text. Hover: darker plum. Disabled until service, time and valid details are present: pale grey. While sending: shows "Sending…" and is disabled.
- Confirmation card: replaces the three cards, white raised, with a green (#2E7D4F) check, the booking summary and a status badge "Requested" in amber (#E0A526) with dark text, and a "Book another" outlined button. A badge for "Confirmed" is green with white text.
- Error banner: a red-tinted bar above the submit button when sending fails or the slot has just been taken.

## 3. How it is used
- Click or tap a service card: selects it, loads days and times, and deselects any earlier time.
- Click or tap a day tile: shows that day's times and clears any chosen time.
- Click or tap a free time pill: selects it and updates the summary line.
- Click a different pill: moves the selection to it.
- Type in Name, Phone or Email: fills the field and clears its error.
- Leave a field: checks it and shows any error.
- Click or tap "Request booking": checks everything, then submits and shows the confirmation.
- Press Enter in a field: acts as pressing "Request booking".
- Click "Book another": clears everything and returns to the service step.

## 4. Scope
One loop: choose a service, day and time, give contact details, submit, and see the request. Out of scope: staff rosters and stylist choice, payments and deposits, product sales, and loyalty.

## 5. Things and their states
- **Service**: name, duration in minutes. It does not change.
- **Time slot**: date, start time, state Free or Taken. Free becomes Taken when a booking claims it.
- **Booking**: service, slot, name, phone, email, status. It is created as Requested and becomes Confirmed when the salon confirms it outside the interface. The client sees the status.

## 6. Rules
- A service must be chosen before days and times are offered; otherwise the strip stays disabled.
- Only Free slots can be chosen; a click on a Taken slot is ignored.
- A slot must fit the service's duration before closing time; slots that do not fit are shown as Taken.
- A booking needs a service, a slot, a name, a phone and a valid email; otherwise submit is refused with field messages.
- Name must be non-empty after trimming and at most 80 characters.
- Phone must have 7–15 digits; spaces, dashes, brackets and a leading + are allowed.
- Email must have the form name@domain.
- Past days and past times are never offered.
- Only the next 14 days can be booked.
- A slot taken by one booking cannot be booked again; if it was taken meanwhile, the client sees "That time was just taken, please pick another" and the time list refreshes.
- A booking made covers the service's full duration, and overlapping slots become Taken.
- Every new booking has status Requested.
- Double submits are ignored while sending.
entities_block:
- **Service** (shown to audience: its records are loaded from the API): [id: string, name: string, duration_minutes: int]
- **TimeSlot** (shown to audience: its records are loaded from the API): [id: string, slot_date: datetime, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime, state: string]
- **Booking** (created by audience): [id: string, service_id: string, time_slot_id: string, client_name: string, client_phone: string, client_email: string, status: string, created_at: datetime]
action_protocol_block:
The rules the product enforces (plan the audience's side of them; the business's own back-office handling is out of view):
- [Service card shows name and duration] (Service): Given a service Cut with duration 45 minutes exists When the booking page lists services Then the card reads 'Cut, 45 min' in a white outlined card
- [Service duration is fixed] (Service): Given a service with duration 45 minutes exists When a client books that service Then the service duration remains 45 minutes
- [Service selection loads days and clears time] (Booking): Given a client has selected a time slot for service Cut When the client selects service Colour Then the chosen time slot is cleared and the day and time options are loaded for Colour
- [Service selected visual state] (Service): Given the service cards are shown When a client hovers a card Then its border turns rose; When the client selects a card Then it shows a plum border, pale rose fill and check mark
- [Day strip disabled before service chosen] (Booking): Given no service has been chosen When the client views the day strip Then the strip is faded and no day is clickable
- [Day strip visual before service chosen] (Booking): Given no service is selected When the page renders the day strip Then the strip appears faded and disabled
- [Day strip shows next 14 days] (TimeSlot): Given the current date is D When the day strip renders Then it shows 14 tiles from D to D+13 each with weekday and date
- [Today marked with rose dot] (TimeSlot): Given today is among the displayed days When the day strip renders Then today's tile shows a small rose dot
- [Selected day visual state] (TimeSlot): Given a client selects a day tile When the strip updates Then that tile is solid plum with white text
- [Day with no free times is not clickable] (TimeSlot): Given a day has no free times for the chosen service When the day strip renders Then that day's text is grey and clicking it has no effect
- [Day selection shows its times and clears time] (Booking): Given a time slot 10:00 is chosen on day D When the client selects day D+1 Then the times for D+1 are shown and the 10:00 selection is cleared
- [Empty-times note] (TimeSlot): Given the client chooses a day with no free times When the time grid renders Then a grey note appears under the day strip
- [Only free slots can be chosen] (TimeSlot): Given a time slot 11:00 is Taken When the client clicks it Then the selection does not change and no slot is chosen
- [Free slot selection updates summary] (Booking): Given a free time slot 09:30 for day D is shown When the client clicks it Then it becomes the selected slot and the summary shows 09:30
- [Moving selection to another pill] (Booking): Given slot 09:30 is selected When the client clicks free slot 10:30 Then 10:30 is the only selected slot and 09:30 is deselected
- [Time slot pill visual states] (TimeSlot): Given the time grid renders free, selected and taken slots Then free is white with plum outline, selected is solid plum with white text, and taken is grey #E4E0DC with struck-through text
- [Free slot becomes Taken when claimed] (TimeSlot): Given time slot 14:00 is Free When a booking is created for it Then the slot state becomes Taken
- [Slot must fit service duration before closing] (TimeSlot): Given closing time is 18:00 and service duration is 45 minutes When the 17:30 slot is evaluated Then it is shown as Taken; When the 17:00 slot is evaluated Then it is Free
- [Past days and times never offered] (TimeSlot): Given the current time is 12:00 today When the day strip and time grid render Then yesterday is not offered and today's 09:00 slot is not offered
- [Only next 14 days bookable] (TimeSlot): Given today is D When a client attempts to book a slot on D+15 Then the booking is refused and the slot is not offered
- [Taken slot cannot be booked again] (Booking): Given slot 11:00 is already claimed by booking B1 When another client submits a booking for slot 11:00 Then the submission is refused
- [Just-taken slot message and refresh] (Booking): Given the client submits slot 11:00 which was taken meanwhile When the submission is refused Then the message 'That time was just taken, please pick another' is shown and the time list is refreshed
- [Booking covers full service duration] (TimeSlot): Given a 60-minute service is booked at 10:00 When the booking is created Then the time covered is 10:00 to 11:00
- [Overlapping slots become Taken] (TimeSlot): Given a 60-minute booking at 10:00 is created and slots 10:30 and 11:00 are Free When the booking is saved Then slot 10:30 becomes Taken and slot 11:00 remains Free
- [Booking requires service, slot and valid details] (Booking): Given the client has no slot selected or an invalid email When the client submits Then submission is refused and a field message is shown for each missing or invalid item
- [Name length and content rule] (Booking): Given the name field contains only spaces When the client leaves it Then an error is shown; Given the name has 81 characters When submitted Then submission is refused; Given the name has 80 characters When submitted Then it is accepted
- [Phone digit count and allowed characters] (Booking): Given phone '+44 (20) 7946-0958' When validated Then it is accepted; Given phone '12345' When validated Then it is refused; Given phone '123456789012345678' When validated Then it is refused
- [Email format rule] (Booking): Given email 'jane@salon' When validated Then it is refused; Given email 'jane@example.com' When validated Then it is accepted
- [New booking status is Requested] (Booking): Given valid details and a free slot When the client submits the booking Then the booking is stored with status Requested
- [Salon confirms booking outside interface] (Booking): Given booking B1 has status Requested When the salon confirms it outside the interface Then B1 status becomes Confirmed and the client sees Confirmed; When the client attempts to confirm it Then no confirmation occurs
- [Status badge visual] (Booking): Given a booking has status Requested When the confirmation renders Then the badge is amber #E0A526 with dark text; Given status Confirmed Then the badge is green #2E7D4F with white text
- [Double submit ignored while sending] (Booking): Given a booking request is in progress When the client submits again Then no second booking request is sent
- [Submit button enabled only when complete] (Booking): Given service and time are chosen but name is empty When the page renders Then the Request booking button is pale grey and disabled
- [Submit button sending state] (Booking): Given the booking is being sent When the button renders Then it reads 'Sending…' and is disabled; Given the button is enabled and hovered Then it shows darker plum
- [Enter key submits] (Booking): Given all details are valid When the client presses Enter in the Email field Then the booking is submitted as if Request booking was clicked
- [Field validated on leave] (Booking): Given the Phone field contains '12' When the client leaves the field Then a phone error message is shown beneath it
- [Typing clears field error] (Booking): Given the Email field shows an error When the client types in it Then the error message is cleared
- [Field focus and error visuals] (Booking): Given the Name field is focused Then it has a plum outline; Given the Email field is invalid Then it has a red #B3261E outline and red message beneath
- [Submit validates everything] (Booking): Given all details are valid and the slot is free When the client clicks Request booking Then the request is submitted and the confirmation card is shown
- [Error banner on failed send] (Booking): Given the booking request fails to send When the response returns Then a red-tinted error banner is shown above the Request booking button
- [Summary line content] (Booking): Given service Cut, day Monday, slot 10:00 with 45 minutes duration are chosen When the summary renders Then it shows 'Cut, Monday, 10:00 – 10:45' in plum text
- [Confirmation card replaces steps] (Booking): Given a booking is submitted successfully When the confirmation renders Then the Service, Time and Your details cards are replaced by a white card with green check, summary and amber 'Requested' badge
- [Book another resets flow] (Booking): Given the confirmation card is shown When the client clicks Book another Then all selections and entered details are cleared and the service step is shown
- [Page layout] (Booking): Given the booking page loads When it renders Then the background is #FAF6F2 full width, the header is a plum band with white 'Book an appointment', and the Service, Time and Your details cards are stacked in a centred 640px column
- [No out-of-scope choices offered] (Booking): Given the client progresses through the booking flow When each step is shown Then no stylist selection, payment, deposit, product or loyalty control appears
intent_block:
- Product type: customer_app
- Audience: Hair salon clients booking appointments
- Goal: Let clients see available appointment times and book a hair salon service without phoning the salon.
- Scope: A single booking page where clients choose a service and time slot and submit their contact details to create a booking.
- The model must cover: Services offered and their durations; Available appointment time slots; Client booking requests with contact details; Booking status (requested or confirmed)
- Do NOT model: Staff rosters and stylist assignment; Online payments and deposits; Inventory and product sales; Client loyalty programmes
